caption: The drawing features two metallic containers placed side by side against an off-white or beige background. The object on the left is a cylindrical canister with a slightly rounded, domed lid featuring a curved handle on top. It has a spout that extends outward at an angle on the upper right side, and there is a handle on the side for carrying, attached to the body with a wire or metal string. Another handle, which appears to be made of a different material, possibly wood, is on the side for easy carrying. The object on the right is a jug or pitcher with a conical bottom, a gently curved spout, and an arched handle attached to the back. Both objects are rendered in shades of gray and silver with subtle shading and highlights to indicate their metallic surfaces, rivets, and seams. The overall composition consists of the two objects centrally arranged with no background elements or additional decorations.
title: Zoar Tin Coffee Pot and Pail
